verifiedFindings: ConnectorModel unique key is @@unique([connectorId, modelKey]); provider is fixed per Connector, so the same modelKey under two connectors is two rows.
connector-models.repository.ts replaceMany HARD-DELETES any model absent from the incoming sync (modelKey notIn), destroying history on one bad provider response. Pack forbids this.
GET /connectors/:id/models has no @RequirePermissions while every sibling route requires ADMIN_CONNECTORS_MANAGE.
PlanModelAccess (auth-service) stores provider/model as free strings with no relation to ConnectorModel (connector-service); nothing validates an assignment against synced inventory.
entitlements.service.ts resolveModelAccessMode returns ALLOW_ALL for any admin; non-admins default to DENY_ALL (fail-closed default, verified).
applyPlanModelGate treats an EMPTY allowedModels array as unrestricted allow-all, by design comment - so a plan with zero rows grants every model.
access-control.service.ts assertCanUseCritic and assertResearchAccess return early with an explicit // fail-open comment when entitlements are null. Pack requires fail-closed.
Two independent gates already exist: applyPlanModelGate (routing-service) and AccessControlService.assertModelAllowed (chat-service). Neither consults connector inventory; both trust plan rows.

batches.migrationEvidence: Executed against claw-pg-connector (PostgreSQL 16.13) inside a transaction and rolled back. All statements succeeded; 160 existing connector_models rows, 160 defaulted to UNEXPOSED. Nothing was persisted.

policy.gates: ONE run at the very end of the flagship only. No per-edit or per-batch lint/test/build.
policy.commandApproval: supervisor approves every terminal command; gate commands rejected until the end

knownCeiling: A coding-agent run is bounded at ~100 tool calls: maxModelTurns and maxToolRounds are debited 1:1 per invocation and both are capped at 100 by the protocol schema in BOTH repos, so ULTRA maxToolCalls 250 is unreachable. Every batch must be scoped to fit well under 100 tool calls. Raising it needs a coordinated protocol change in claw-coding-agent and claw-chat-service.
method: The agent ignores prompt-level tool budgets and dies at ~100 model turns. Discovery-shaped tasks fail. Working shape: supervisor names an exact short read list, agent traces and authors. Confirmed on batch 1a.
adrCorrections: ADR proposed an exposure enum containing DEPRECATED; dropped, because ModelLifecycle already owns DEPRECATED and SUNSET and two enums encoding the same concept produce contradictory states.

ADR proposed a foreign key from PlanModelAccess to ConnectorModel; impossible, they live in different service databases and this repository forbids crossing a service database boundary. The link must be a plain column validated over HTTP.
openCaveats: exposure is stored but not yet enforced anywhere: getAvailableModels, findAllForSnapshot and both runtime gates still ignore it. Batch 5 wires the exposure backend, Batch 9 the canonical gate. Until then the column is inert and behaviour is unchanged for users.
